text:
incident-bot: \ud83d\udd14 [P1] Several inference-usw-edge nodes flapping -> NotReady. kubelet restarts and container OOMs observed. Auto-generated incident 2026-03-12T11:21:07Z

ops-bot: Paging maya (oncall). Please acknowledge. Affects inference-usw-edge pool, elevated 5xx and p99 latency.

maya: ack. joining. quick triage: which nodes?

sam: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-usw-edge -o wide` -> infer-edge-11, infer-edge-14, infer-edge-18 showing NotReady. Restart count for kubelet on those hosts jumped around 11:19 UTC.

jules: prometheus shows pod RestartCount spikes at ~11:20 and runtime pod 5xx began at 11:21. Router error rate climbed on routes for heavy-embed tenants.

devon: getting logs. Container logs show `E runtime: gpu driver lost context` and `RuntimeOOM` then pods crash. Kernel dmesg has: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:07:00): 13, GPU has fallen off the bus` which points at GPU/PCI fault.

alice: customer impact: two high-volume customers hit >20% errors; others degraded. Marking incident as customer-facing and creating slack thread for comms.

maya: mitigation plan: 1) cordon/drain unhealthy nodes 2) shift traffic to inference-usw-fallback and us-east fallback as cross-region buffer 3) spin new hosts to replenish capacity 4) collect full host diagnostics and open infra ticket. Who can run node drains?

sam: I'll cordon/drain. starting with infer-edge-11.

sam: `kubectl cordon infer-edge-11`
sam: `kubectl drain infer-edge-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`

sam: drain shows some runtime pods failing to evict due to container runtime not responding. Logs show `containerd: failed to stop task: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = process not responding`

jules: those failed pods have CUDA faults. Sample snippet from pod log: 

```
E0312 11:20:45.678 runtime.cc:412] cuda: driver lost context, aborting batch
E0312 11:20:46.102 runtime.cc:500] Process terminated by OOM killer: pid=13421 name=runtime_worker
```

devon: grabbing `journalctl -u kubelet -n 300` and `dmesg --ctime | tail -n 200` from infer-edge-11. Kubelet shows `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing` before restart. dmesg shows `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:07:00): 13` followed by `gpu reset failed`

sam: pasted truncated dmesg: 

```
Mar 12 11:19:58 infer-edge-11 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:07:00): 13, pid=0, GPU has fallen off the bus
Mar 12 11:20:00 infer-edge-11 systemd[1]: nvidia-driver.service: main process exited, status=6/ABRT
Mar 12 11:20:02 infer-edge-11 kubelet[2345]: E0312 11:20:02.345 kubelet_node_status.go:99] kubelet: runtime service not responding: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```

jules: this is consistent across the three nodes -> hardware or driver/firmware regression. Avoid pushing kernel or driver changes mid-incident.

maya: agreed. Short term: redirect traffic + spin replacements. sam, tag infra. devon, can you scale fallback pools and nudge cross-region routing?

devon: scaling `infer-fallback` deployments in us-west-2 from 4 -> 10 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/infer-runtime-fallback -n production --replicas=10`
devon: enabling cross-region spill to inference-useast-fallback at 25% for critical routes via `rh-routerctl`:

`rh-routerctl set-weight inference-usw inference-useast-fallback 25 --routes=embed,gen --duration=30m`

alice: sending initial comms to impacted customers: "We've detected GPU host instability in us-west-2 inference pool; traffic shifted to fallback; mitigations underway; will update within 30 minutes."

ops-bot: infra request created INF-EDGE-4021 to provision 3 replacement hosts in us-west-2. Estimated provisioning 10-15m.

maya: while replacements provision, increase kubelet eviction timeout from 1m -> 4m to reduce cascade. devon?

devon: applying kubelet configmap change now and doing rolling restart via machine agent to avoid full node reboots.

devon: applied change. watching for stability.

sam: infra reports new instances booting, attaching to ASG. Will post when they become Ready.

jules: side note: a few of the crash logs show `MIG` config mismatch warnings — check that golden image uses consistent MIG partitioning for the runtime AMI. Action item for infra later.

alice: customer update posted. support triage assigned tickets to escalation team.

maya: handoff: I need to step out for an ops sync in 25m. sam please take lead. Summary: suspected GPU PCI/GPU driver fault (Xid 13) causing driver crash -> kubelet/CRI flapping -> pod OOMs and 5xx. Mitigation: cordon/drain affected nodes, scale fallback, cross-region spill, provision replacements, increase eviction timeout.

sam: taking lead. ack. I'll continue log collection and coordinate infra.

incident-bot: If no stabilization in 20m escalate to SRE lead.

sam: new hosts are Ready at 11:37 UTC. Verified `kubectl get nodes` shows 3 new nodes labelled pool=inference-usw-edge. Starting slow ramp of traffic back to primary: pulling back cross-region spill in 10% steps every 5m.

devon: validated driver on new hosts: `nvidia-smi -q` clean, no Xid. Also rolled runtime to driver-aware image `runtime:stable-20260312` to align userspace.

jules: by 11:50 latency and errors down to baseline. Two tenants still show elevated errors; support following up.

alice: updated impacted customers with ETA and mitigation summary.

sam: nodes infer-edge-11/14/18 are cordoned and scheduled for hardware diagnostics. I've added taint `hardware.issue=true:NoSchedule` to keep them out.

maya: follow-ups: 1) infra to add GPU PCI stress test in node warmup 2) add AMI preflight to validate MIG/driver/kernel combos 3) router: auto-ramp fallback when >N nodes NotReady 4) incident automation: attach `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi` outputs to pagerduty incident. Assign owners and timelines.

incident-bot: Severity reduced to P2 at 12:02 UTC. Monitoring.

sam: will create postmortem doc and assign action items in the incident tracker.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll review the postmortem draft when available. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed and moved to monitoring at 12:20 UTC.
